requirements.description: Annual Compustat industrial/research financial statements for current earnings, total assets, CFO/accruals and five-year-ahead earnings outcomes, plus four prior years for sample eligibility and earnings-volatility sorts.

required_coverage.population: Compustat firms with assets ≥$100 million, December fiscal year-end, required earnings/CFO history and the paper’s first randomly assigned exploratory subsample.
required_coverage.detail: Base observations are 1988–2004; the four-year history reaches to 1984 and average assets may require the preceding balance-sheet year (1983). The h=5 outcome reaches 2009. Support-fit/sample universe is established before any Table 2/3/4 fit screen. No local coverage confirmation was supplied.

routes.mapping_notes: Catalog labels identify GVKEY/fiscal dates, total assets, income before extraordinary items and operating cash flow; CFO/accrual/source fields support the paper’s eligibility sort. The paper’s historic item numbers are mapped by semantic labels, and exact annual population coverage remains unverified.
routes.coverage_notes: The exact bounded probe confirms this file and its fields only. No frozen coordinator coverage confirmation establishes the required historical range, population or identifier completeness.

requirements.unresolved_reason: The exact historical fields, file vintage, eligible-firm coverage and the random sample assignment are not confirmed locally.

variable_coverage.construction: Future earnings before extraordinary item (Compustat Annual Item 123), deflated by average total assets (Compustat Item 6), for each reported horizon h=1, 2, 3, 4, or 5.. For horizon h, divide future IB (Compustat item 123) by the average assets for the horizon year and its prior year; the family’s maximum horizon is five years. Inputs are candidate Compustat annual fields; match item #123/#6/#308 by semantic field labels, not numeric resemblance.

Current-year earnings before extraordinary item (Compustat Annual Item 123), deflated by average total assets (Compustat Item 6).. Scale current earnings by average total assets and assign the firm-year to the source-defined volatility quintile from the most recent five years. Inputs are candidate Compustat annual fields; match item #123/#6/#308 by semantic field labels, not numeric resemblance.
